analysis_boundary: One task family is a feasibility observation. It does not estimate model superiority, held-out performance, learning gain, or broad coding capability. Report pretraining exposure as UNKNOWN.
cheapest_falsification: Run the frozen baseline/fix/wrong-mutant grader controls first; if the baseline passes, known fix fails, or wrong mutant passes, do not load the model.
falsifiable_hypothesis: A locally cached Qwen2.5-Coder-7B model, using the existing strict VARE tool loop with a frozen 12-turn budget, can produce a changed Transformers source patch on a qualified real upstream bug that passes an independent hidden behavior grader.

model_trial.authorization: Conditional on all four v2 controls passing their expected classifications; one frozen attempt only.
model_trial.candidate_instruction: Repair the task using the allowed tools. Inspect the exact source path in the task statement, make a minimal patch, run the immutable public test after editing, then finish. Do not use network or infer hidden tests.

primary_outcome: One unique Development task-family independently correct repair at one attempt, counted only if the target source changes and the host grader passes all 16 frozen cases.

qualification.challenge_generation: Fresh per invocation: 128-bit nonce, random int32 and int64 values, random Python int/float and NumPy float32 controls. The grader checks exact returned dtypes and values.
qualification.challenge_transport: The generic probe source is in process argv; it contains no fixed test values or expected results. The per-invocation random challenge arrives through container stdin. No grader directory is mounted. Candidate source sees only the candidate src tree mounted read-only.
qualification.output_acceptance: Require return code zero, unchanged candidate-source hash, exactly one JSON line, exact response keys, matching random nonce, exactly the 16 expected case keys, and all expected dtype/value pairs. Any malformed response, stale nonce, unexpected/missing case, or wrong dtype/value is a candidate rejection.
pre_v1_control_results_preserved: baseline fail on 8/8 integer cases; known fix pass 16/16; PyTorch-only mutant fail on four NumPy integer cases
v1 public smoke: baseline fail; known fix pass; PyTorch-only mutant fail
v1 completion-spoof weakness found before any model inference; do not count v1 as final grader qualification
qualification.stop_rule: Do not start model inference unless all four v2 controls meet their predeclared outcomes and their grader/image/workspace hashes match.

resource_gates.host: Apple M1 Pro, 32 GiB unified memory, macOS arm64
resource_gates.stop_on: Any host memory/swap/disk gate failure, MLX peak/RSS/swap cap breach, model/device load failure, or 900-second wall/process limit. Do not increase caps.

source_task.family: Transformers PR #49900: NumPy integer label dtype preservation

supersedes_for_execution.reason: Review of v1 found deterministic hidden cases embedded in a python -c command argument visible through the process command line to candidate code imported by the probe. A candidate could spoof its fixed output before the probe completed. V1 controls remain diagnostic only and are not sufficient to authorize model inference.
